_meta.description: Heart event #5 for npc_paige: The Laugh

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Paige and Jack are organizing books. Jack makes an unexpected joke]

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: That's — ha! That's not even — HA!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Paige laughs. Really, genuinely laughs. Then stops, surprised]

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I haven't laughed like that in years.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: I'd forgotten what it sounded like. My own laugh.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Isn't that strange? Forgetting your own laugh?

options.text: It's been waiting for the right moment.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: ...Don't make me laugh again. I might get used to it.

lines.speaker: npc_paige
lines.text: Actually... please do. Make me laugh again.
